background: HSBC Holdings is the listed holding company of HSBC, one of the world's largest banks, with its main earnings in Hong Kong and the UK and a global transaction banking, wealth and trade franchise.
synthesis: Rated A on average across two of the three, the weakest of them at A-, one on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, the group holds a solid single-A standing. Capital is strong against UK majors, with CET1 of 14.1% and leverage of 4.9% both above the median. Liquidity is mixed, with NSFR of 140% in the top quarter but LCR of 134% in the bottom quarter. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 and leverage have each fallen 0.5 points and NSFR 5 points, modest declines, and the newest flagged items, on 7 Oct 2026, concern job cuts in the UK wealth business.
